summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing Q1 2026 results and management changes. The filing reports record revenue of $7.2M, Adjusted EBITDA of $7.0M, and 1,920 GEOs. Management appointments include John Griffith as President and Jackie Przybylowski as VP of Capital Markets and Sustainability, replacing Katherine Arblaster. This is a routine earnings release with internal personnel moves, not an abrupt departure or a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review is disclosed. The filing is a standard quarterly update for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic earnings press release.
